title: E-commerce batch and streaming ETL pipeline
blurb: Python, PySpark, SQL, Airflow, Docker, Kafka and an LLM on Olist-shaped e-commerce data. Pick a goal: a step of the project or the whole of it. The page shows only the topics that goal needs, leaves out what you already know, and puts the rest in order.

steps.title: Data sources and profiling
steps.builds: Source contract, synthetic generator with ground-truth defects, Olist download, profiler.
done: generate and profile run
you can explain each difference between the profile and _manifest.json

steps.title: Postgres landing zone and normalisation
steps.builds: Postgres in Docker, COPY into raw, a 3NF core schema with keys and constraints.
done: load-raw and build-core run in Docker
you can explain every raw versus core count difference

steps.title: Batch with PySpark: bronze to silver
steps.builds: Bronze and silver Parquet layers, quarantine with reason codes, deduplication.
done: silver counts equal the Postgres core counts
you can name the reason codes and where each comes from

steps.title: Star schema and SCD Type 2
steps.builds: Two facts, SCD Type 2 customers, surrogate keys, the unknown member, load to Postgres.
done: gold loads into Postgres with constraints
you can show a person with two versions and the orders on each

steps.title: Data quality framework
steps.builds: 115 checks (80 row rules, 35 gates), blocking gates, check history, precision and recall.
done: quality runs and stores its history
you can explain write-audit-publish and the precision of the checks

steps.title: SQL analysis and dashboard
steps.builds: Ten business questions in SQL and a tested Streamlit dashboard.
done: analyze runs
the dashboard shows sales, delivery, customers and data quality

steps.title: Performance tuning
steps.builds: Benchmark ablation (176.9 s to 33.0 s), partition pruning, Postgres indexes with EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
done: you can explain each row of the ablation table
you can read a stage in the Spark UI

steps.title: Orchestration with Airflow
steps.builds: Airflow 3 in Docker, the batch DAG with gates, retries and params, DAG tests in CI.
done: the DAG runs green in the Airflow UI
you can show what a failed gate stops

steps.title: Streaming with Kafka
steps.builds: Kafka in Docker, an event producer with duplicates, late and malformed messages, four Structured Streaming queries, an idempotent Postgres sink.
done: produce and stream run in Docker
you can explain watermarks and exactly-once results

steps.title: Cloud platforms and wrap-up
steps.builds: The Spark job on Databricks, gold in Snowflake, final numbers and stories.
done: the cloud scripts are explained
RESULTS.md and STORIES.md are complete

steps.title: LLM enrichment of review comments
steps.builds: Sentiment, topics and a follow-up flag for Olist review comments with Gemini or a local model: deduplication, a content-hash cache, batching, validation with quarantine and a 2% gate, measured against stars and a keyword baseline.
done: the sample run prints a report and a second run makes 0 requests
the Olist run is done on Kaggle or the V100 and its numbers are in RESULTS.md

whole.title: The whole project
whole.summary: All eleven steps, from source files to a tested star schema, Airflow, a Kafka stream and LLM enrichment of review comments.
